summary: Borgestad ASA, an investment company, focuses on real estate and refractory in Norway. The company also develops and manages real estate properties. It operates Agora Bytom, a shopping center and a rental area, as well as a parking garage with parking spaces in Poland. In addition, the company Höganäs Borgestad, which offers refractory products, systems, and installation services. Borgestad ASA was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Lysaker, Norway.
